value.title: PRD 009: docs in the pij CLI
value.summary: The pij CLI carries its own documentation: a start page for an agent that has just met pij, and reference pages any seat can list and read in any repo. The first pages explain the fleet's constructs: role, type, position, pod and template.

sections.name: why
sections.value: pij's documentation lives in three places a working seat often cannot reach. The skill is a set of job routes loaded one at a time by an agent that invokes it. `--help` covers one verb at a time. `docs/how/` is only in the pij repo, so a seat in another project cannot read it. `pij docs` is refused today as an unknown verb. There is no single page that says what a role, a type, a pod or a template is and how they relate, and the fleet's constructs are about to grow (PRDs 006, 007 and 008). A sibling tool already ships its docs inside its binary with a start page for agents, and that pattern has worked.

value.name: any seat
value.need: Read what a pij term or command means from wherever it is working, without loading the skill.

value.name: new agent
value.need: Learn in one page what pij is, what it is here, and what to run first.

value.name: maintainer
value.need: Keep one copy of each page.

value.goal: A seat in any repo answers "what is this and how do I use it" with one pij command.
The docs a seat reads always match the pij it is running.

value.text: Moving all of `docs/how/` into the CLI now. This PRD ships the start page and the pages for the fleet's constructs; the rest can follow.
Replacing the skill. The skill keeps the judgment (when to create a role, which type fits); the CLI carries reference.
A website or a search service.

value.title: A start page for agents
value.statement: `pij agents-start-here` prints one page: what pij is, how a seat finds out who it is and who governs it, and the first commands to run. It needs no daemon.
value.done_when: With the daemon stopped, the command prints the page and exits zero.
value.source: operator, 2026-11-25: docs list and get and agents start here

value.title: List and read pages
value.statement: `pij docs list` shows every page with one line each. `pij docs get <page>` prints one, and `pij docs get <page>#<heading>` prints one section of it.
value.done_when: `list` names every bundled page; `get` on a page and on one of its headings prints the whole page and only that section; an unknown page refuses and suggests the nearest name.

value.title: The docs come with the binary
value.statement: The pages are inside the installed pij, so they match its version and read the same in any repo, with no daemon and no network.
value.done_when: From a directory outside any repo, with the daemon stopped and the network off, `pij docs get concepts` prints the page.

value.title: One copy of each page
value.statement: A bundled page and its file in the pij repo are the same source. A check fails when a page that is bundled differs from its file.
value.done_when: Editing a page's file without rebuilding makes `harness checks` fail and name the page.

value.title: The first pages explain the fleet's constructs
value.statement: The first set of pages is: the start page; a concepts page covering seat, role, type, position, pod, seed and template, and how governance (the team) differs from the repo (the work), with one build fleet and one operating fleet as examples; one page per seat type; pods; and how to build a role on a type.
value.done_when: `pij docs list` names each of those pages, and the concepts page defines every one of the seven terms.
value.source: operator, 2026-11-25: we don't document the fleet and its semantics and constructs very well
value.note: In progress: every page but pods shipped with #348 (plan 246). The pods page waits on workstream 008 step s02 and comes in a follow-up PR.

value.title: Refusals and first turns point at pages
value.statement: A refusal that turns on a concept names the page that explains it, and a seat's first turn names the page for its type instead of carrying the full text.
value.done_when: `pij directory add` refused for a missing type prints `pij docs get types`, and a knowledge seat's first turn names `pij docs get types/knowledge`.

value.title: Reading docs launches nothing
value.statement: `agents-start-here`, `docs list` and `docs get` start no process beyond the command itself and contact no daemon.
value.done_when: `pij-rs --json ping | jq .data.spawns` does not move across ten `docs get` calls.
value.source: AGENTS.md: resource cost is a correctness property

value.question: Do the docs verbs live in the native binary or in the shim?
value.default: The native binary, so the pages are fixed at build time with the version.

value.change: Ownership moved from pij-autonomous-parrot to pm-001 for the build.
